gui.vanillasugar.quest_opt_in.title: Quest Journal
gui.vanillasugar.quest_opt_in.text: Would you like a quest journal to guide you? It leads you step by step through everything Minecraft has to offer: where to go, what to craft, what to look for. The current quest shows on the side of the screen.
gui.vanillasugar.quest_opt_in.note: You can change your mind at any time in the journal (%s key).
quest.vanillasugar.chapter.first_steps.d: An unknown world lies before you. Before nightfall, you need tools, shelter and something to eat.
quest.vanillasugar.chapter.iron_age.desc: Iron changes everything: real tools, armor, a bucket. Enough to go deeper without fear.
quest.vanillasugar.chapter.diamonds.desc: Diamonds sleep far below, near the lava. They open the way to obsidian and enchanting.
quest.vanillasugar.chapter.nether.descri: A dimension of fire and lava, home to Piglins and Ghasts. Get ready before stepping through the portal.
quest.vanillasugar.chapter.fortress.desc: Nether fortresses shelter Blazes, whose rods unlock brewing, and Wither Skeletons.
quest.vanillasugar.chapter.the_end.descr: Eyes of Ender lead to a buried stronghold, and to a portal to the dragon.
quest.vanillasugar.chapter.villages.desc: Villagers trade in everything, but pillagers prowl. Their villages are yours to defend.
quest.vanillasugar.chapter.farm.descript: Crops, animals, bees and fish: never run short of anything again.
quest.vanillasugar.chapter.wilderness.de: Frogs, axolotls, parrots, sniffers: the world teems with creatures to watch.
quest.vanillasugar.chapter.ruins.descrip: Buried ruins, trial chambers and an ancient city: the world still bears the marks of those who lived in it.
quest.vanillasugar.chapter.legends.descr: The feats of a lifetime: see everything, taste everything, defeat everything.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.story.root: Punch a tree to gather logs, turn them into planks in your inventory, then craft a crafting table.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.root: Eat something: an apple dropped by leaves, cooked meat or berries. Hunger is unforgiving.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.story.mine_stone: On the crafting table, make a wooden pickaxe from planks and sticks, then dig down to stone.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.story.upgrade_to: With three cobblestone and two sticks, craft a stone pickaxe: sturdier, and it can mine iron.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.root: When night falls, monsters come out of the dark. Face one: win or lose, the adventure begins.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.kill_a: Craft a sword and slay a monster: zombies, skeletons and spiders roam every night.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.sleep_: Gather wool from three sheep, craft a bed with three planks and sleep in it: that's where you'll respawn.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.story.smelt_iron: Iron hides in stone as beige and orange specks. Smelt the raw ore in a furnace, fuelled with coal or wood.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.story.iron_tools: Three iron ingots and two sticks make an iron pickaxe, the only one that can mine diamonds.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.story.obtain_arm: Craft a piece of iron armor: a chestplate takes eight ingots, a helmet five.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.story.deflect_ar: Craft a shield (six planks and an iron ingot), hold it in your off hand and raise it against a skeleton.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.shoot_: A bow takes three sticks and three strings, dropped by spiders. Shoot an arrow at anything.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.ol_bet: Craft a crossbow from sticks, string, an iron ingot and a tripwire hook, then fire it.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.story.lava_bucke: Three iron ingots in a V make a bucket. Fill it at a lava lake, on the surface or in caves, without falling in!
quest.vanillasugar.hint.story.mine_diamo: Diamonds lie far below, under the deepslate line, often near lava. Mine them with an iron pickaxe.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.story.form_obsid: Pour water onto a lava source: it turns into obsidian. Mine it with a diamond pickaxe.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.story.shiny_gear: Craft a piece of diamond armor: a chestplate takes eight diamonds, boots four.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.story.enchant_it: An enchanting table takes two diamonds, four obsidian and a book. Surround it with bookshelves, then pay in lapis lazuli.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.read_p: Put books in a chiseled bookshelf and place a comparator against it: its signal tells which slot was used last.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.crafte: A crafter crafts on its own when it gets a redstone signal. Lay out the crafter's recipe in one and power it.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.story.enter_the_: Build an obsidian frame four blocks wide and five tall, light it with flint and steel and step through the purple portal.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.nether.root: Simply arrive in the Nether. Note the portal's coordinates to find your way home.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.nether.distract_: Wear at least one piece of gold armor so Piglins leave you alone, then throw them a gold ingot: they'll give you something in return.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.nether.obtain_cr: Piglins barter it for gold, and ruined portals and bastions hold some. Mine it with a diamond pickaxe.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.nether.charge_re: A respawn anchor takes six crying obsidian and three glowstone. Charge it four times with glowstone.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.nether.ride_stri: Striders walk on lava lakes. Saddle one, then steer it with a warped fungus on a stick.
Bring a strider to the Overworld through a portal, then ride it a long way across a lava lake.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.nether.find_bast: Bastion remnants are huge blackstone ruins, all over the Nether except the basalt deltas. Beware of Piglin Brutes.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.nether.loot_bast: Open a chest in a bastion. Piglins guard it jealously, even if you wear gold: be ready to run.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.nether.obtain_an: Ancient debris hides low in the Nether, around level 15. A diamond pickaxe mines it, and it withstands explosions.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.nether.fast_trav: One block in the Nether is worth eight in the Overworld. Travel 875 blocks in the Nether, then come out through a new portal.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.nether.return_to: When a Ghast spits a fireball at you, hit it at the right moment to send it back.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.nether.find_fort: Nether fortresses are long bridges and corridors of dark bricks. Explore the Nether: they can be seen from afar, above the lava lakes.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.nether.obtain_bl: Blazes spawn around the fortresses' monster spawners. Dodge their fireballs, take them down and collect their rods.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.nether.brew_poti: A brewing stand takes a blaze rod and three cobblestone. Fill bottles with water and add a Nether wart, with blaze powder to fuel it.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.story.cure_zombi: Throw a splash potion of weakness at a zombie villager, then give it a golden apple. Keep it out of the sun while it heals.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.nether.get_withe: Wither Skeletons haunt fortresses and sometimes drop their skull. The Looting enchantment raises your chances.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.nether.summon_wi: Place four soul sand or soul soil blocks in a T, then three Wither Skeleton skulls on top. Do it far from home, and get ready to fight!
quest.vanillasugar.hint.nether.create_be: A beacon takes the Nether star dropped by the Wither, three obsidian and five glass. Place it on a pyramid of iron, gold, emerald or diamond blocks.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.nether.create_fu: A beacon at full power sits on a four-level pyramid: 164 blocks of precious ore in all.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.story.follow_end: An eye of ender takes an ender pearl, dropped by Endermen, and blaze powder. Throw it: it flies toward the nearest stronghold.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.story.enter_the_: Where the eyes dive into the ground, dig down to the stronghold. Fill the portal's twelve frames with eyes of ender, then jump in.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.end.root: Here you are in the End. Endermen are everywhere: avoid looking them in the eye.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.end.kill_dragon: First destroy the crystals atop the obsidian pillars with arrows, then bring down the dragon. Take healing and a water bucket.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.end.dragon_egg: The egg sits on the exit portal and teleports when hit. Dig under it, place a torch, then break the block holding it up: it drops and can be picked up.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.end.dragon_breat: During the fight, the dragon breathes a purple cloud. Collect it in an empty bottle.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.end.respawn_drag: Craft four end crystals (glass, an eye of ender and a ghast tear) and place them on the edges of the exit portal: the dragon returns.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.end.enter_end_ga: Once the dragon is defeated, a small gateway appears at the island's edge. Throw an ender pearl into it to reach the outer islands.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.end.find_end_cit: On the outer islands, look for tall purple towers of purpur: those are End cities.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.end.elytra: Some cities have a ship moored to them. The elytra hang there in an item frame, guarded by a Shulker.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.end.levitate: Let a Shulker hit you: you levitate. Rise 50 blocks this way, and plan your way down.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.trade: Each villager has a trade, set by the workstation near them. Trade with one: most buy your goods for emeralds.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.summon: Place four iron blocks in a T and a carved pumpkin on top: an iron golem will watch over the village.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.lightn: During a thunderstorm, place a lightning rod near a villager: it draws the lightning and spares villager and houses.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.trade_: Bring a villager up to the build limit, at the very top of the world, and trade with them up there.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.volunt: Pillager captains carry a banner. They patrol or guard outposts: kill one, but beware of what follows.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.hero_o: Drink an ominous bottle, dropped by captains, then enter a village: a raid begins. Fight off every wave.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.whos_t: Pillagers shoot crossbows. Return the favor: kill one with a crossbow.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.two_bi: Enchant a crossbow with Piercing and shoot down two Phantoms with one bolt. They attack at night when you haven't slept in a while.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.arbali: With a crossbow enchanted with Piercing, kill five different kinds of mobs with one shot. Line them up in a narrow corridor.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.plant_: Till soil near water with a hoe and plant seeds in it: wheat seeds drop from tall grass.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.breed_: Feed two animals of the same kind: wheat for cows and sheep, carrots for pigs, seeds for chickens.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.tame_a: Tame an animal: bones for a wolf, raw fish for a cat, or ride a horse until it accepts you.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.fishy_: Craft a fishing rod from three sticks and two strings, cast it into water and reel in when the bobber dips.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.tactic: Scoop up a live fish with a water bucket: cod, salmon, pufferfish or tropical fish.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.safely: Place a campfire under a hive or nest to calm the bees, then collect the honey with a bottle when it overflows.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.wax_on: Shear a honeycomb from a full hive, then use it on a copper block: it will no longer oxidize.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.wax_of: Scrape a waxed copper block with an axe to remove the wax.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.silk_t: With a Silk Touch tool, break a hive or nest with three bees inside: they come along with it.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.make_a: Glow squids swim in dark deep water. Use their glow ink sac on a sign.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.ride_a: Goats live in the mountains. Lure one into a boat with wheat, and climb in with it.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.remove: Take the armor off a tamed wolf with shears.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.repair: Damaged wolf armor is repaired with armadillo scutes. Make it as good as new.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.allay_: Allays are held captive in pillager outposts and woodland mansions. Free one and give it an item: it will bring you more of the same.
Give a cake to an Allay, then play a note block near it: it will drop the cake there.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.place_: Dried ghasts lie in the fossils of the Nether's soul sand valleys. Place one in water: it will slowly come back to life.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.uh_oh: Sulfur cubes live in sulfur caves. Give a TNT block to a grown cube, by hand or by throwing it, then step back.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.spygla: A spyglass takes two copper ingots and an amethyst shard. Use it to look at a parrot in the jungle.
In the Nether, look at a Ghast through a spyglass.
In the End, look at the Ender Dragon through a spyglass.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.brush_: Armadillos live in savannas and badlands. Brush one to collect a scute.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.honey_: Jump against the side of a honey block: you slide down slowly instead of falling.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.walk_o: Powder snow covers the snowy peaks. Put on leather boots and walk across it without sinking.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.play_j: Place a jukebox in a meadow, the flowery plains at the foot of the mountains, and play a disc in it.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.heart_: The creaking heart hides in the trunks of the pale garden. Mine it with Silk Touch and place it between two pale oak logs, all facing the same way.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.tadpol: Tadpoles swim in swamps. Scoop one up with a water bucket.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.leash_: There are three frogs, temperate, cold and warm, depending on where the tadpole grows up. Get each one on a lead.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.frogli: A frog that eats a small magma cube leaves a froglight of its color. Gather all three in your inventory.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.axolot: Axolotls live in the water of lush caves. Scoop one up with a water bucket.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.kill_a: Fight an aquatic mob with an axolotl at your side: it helps you, and heals you when you win.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.obtain: Brush the suspicious sand of warm ocean ruins to find a sniffer egg.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.feed_s: Hatch the egg, faster on moss, then feed the snifflet torchflower seeds.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.plant_: A grown sniffer digs up ancient seeds by sniffing the ground. Plant one.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.use_lo: A lodestone takes eight chiseled stone bricks and a netherite ingot. Use a compass on it: it will point to it wherever you are.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.salvag: Trail ruins, desert wells and ocean ruins hide suspicious sand and gravel. Brush them.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.craft_: Place four pottery sherds in a diamond on the crafting table to make a decorated pot.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.trim_w: Armor trim templates are found in structures. On a smithing table, combine one with a piece of armor and an ore.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.minecr: Trial chambers are buried underground, built of copper and tuff. Find one and step inside.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.lighte: An oxidized copper bulb gives less light. Scrape it with an axe to make it shine again.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.who_ne: Breezes in trial chambers drop breeze rods, which make wind charges. Throw one at your feet to leap 8 blocks up.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.under_: Once defeated, trial spawners drop trial keys. Open a vault with one.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.revaul: Drink an ominous bottle, then enter a trial chamber: its spawners turn ominous and drop ominous keys. Open an ominous vault with one.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.blowba: When a Breeze throws a wind charge at you, hit it back to defeat the Breeze.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.overov: The mace is made with the heavy core from ominous vaults. Fall from high above onto a mob and strike: 50 hearts in one blow!
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.avoid_: In the deep dark, under the mountains, sculk sensors hear everything. Sneak to pass them without a sound.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.kill_m: Kill a mob near a sculk catalyst in the deep dark: sculk spreads around it.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.throw_: Drowned sometimes drop a trident. Throw it at something, and remember to fetch it.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.very_v: Enchant a trident with Channeling and throw it at a villager during a thunderstorm: lightning strikes them.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.spear_: With a spear, charge an attack on the run and pierce five mobs in a single blow.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.totem_: Evokers in mansions and raids drop the totem of undying. Hold it in your hand when you would die.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.fall_f: Jump from the top of the world to the bottom and survive: a water bucket poured just before impact does the trick.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.bullse: Hit the center of a target block with an arrow from at least 30 blocks away.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.sniper: Shoot down a skeleton with an arrow from 50 blocks or more.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.nether.explore_n: Visit all five Nether biomes: Nether wastes, soul sand valley, crimson forest, warped forest and basalt deltas.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.nether.uneasy_al: Get a Ghast from the Nether through a portal to the Overworld, safe and sound, then kill it there.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.advent: Visit every Overworld biome. The advancements screen lists those you have left.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.kill_a: Kill every hostile mob at least once. The advancements screen lists those you have left.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.balanc: Eat everything edible at least once, even rotten flesh and spider eyes.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.bred_a: Breed every animal that can be bred, from camels to sniffers. The advancements screen lists those you have left.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.comple: Tame every cat variant with raw fish. They live in villages, and a black cat guards every swamp hut.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.whole_: Tame all nine wolf variants, each in its own biome: forests, taigas, savannas, badlands…
quest.vanillasugar.hint.husbandry.obtain: On a smithing table, upgrade a diamond hoe with a netherite ingot and a netherite upgrade template.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.nether.netherite: Upgrade all four pieces of diamond armor to netherite. Each takes an ingot and an upgrade template, found in bastions.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.adventure.trim_w: Apply the eight rare templates: spire, snout, rib, ward, silence, vex, tide and wayfinder. They come from the most remote structures.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.nether.all_potio: Brew every potion and drink them one after another: all their effects must be active at once.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.nether.all_effec: The ultimate challenge: have every effect in the game at once, from potions, mobs, beacons and food.
advancements.vanillasugar.root.title: Vanilla Sugar
advancements.vanillasugar.backpack.title: Packed Up
advancements.vanillasugar.backpack.descr: Wear a backpack in its slot.
advancements.vanillasugar.minimap.title: True North
advancements.vanillasugar.minimap.descri: Wear a compass to show the minimap.
advancements.vanillasugar.world_map.desc: Wear a world map to unlock it.
advancements.vanillasugar.map_marker.des: Place a marker on the world map.
quest.vanillasugar.chapter.explorer_gear: A bag to carry everything, a compass and a world map never to get lost.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.vanillasugar.bac: Craft a backpack from four leather, four string and a bundle, then wear it in its slot next to the off hand. Press %1$s to open it.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.vanillasugar.min: A compass takes four iron ingots and a redstone dust. Wear it in the slot above the off hand: the minimap appears in the top right corner.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.vanillasugar.wor: Surround an empty map with eight sticks to make a world map, then wear it under the compass. The %2$s key opens the world map.
quest.vanillasugar.hint.vanillasugar.map: On the world map, right-click where you want to find your way back, name the marker and press Enter.
